notes: The section covers both the Certificate of Achievement and the Associate in Science; the 18-19-unit major is the certificate's total. The A.S. adds General Education and electives to reach 60 units, which is not recorded for this certificate.
The Program Outcomes list is shared by the Certificate of Achievement and the Associate in Science; it is recorded for this certificate.
